purpose: Power BI Health Assessment scoring and finding framework for productized Fiverr audit.

score.category_formula: category_score = max(0, category_weight - sum(applicable finding deductions))
guardrails: Only applicable, evidence-backed findings affect the score.
Category scores cannot fall below zero.
Manual/hybrid rules require expert validation before delivery.
A rule may be suppressed when the documented exception applies.
Business KPI and governance conclusions must not be inferred from technical metadata alone when customer context is required.

classification.priority_formula: priority_score = severity*2 + business_impact*2 + effort_bonus; effort_bonus = 2 low, 1 medium, 0 high
priority_rules: Critical severity => P1 regardless of numeric score.
classification.quick_win_definition: Business impact medium/high AND effort low AND severity not low.

detection_modes.automatic: Can be detected from model/report metadata or parser output, but may still need sanity review.
detection_modes.hybrid: Machine can flag evidence; expert must confirm context before delivery.
